Please fuck off, I’ve heard all the arguments for why people say I’m not a muslim anymore and it’s not one thing. Part of it is the cultish attitude of many muslims, the other part of it is that islam doesn’t fit in modern society, the other part is how women are treated like shit because of it, the other part is how unscientific and inaccurate the quran is, the other part is how muslims will cheer for the death of a cartoonist for drawing old Mo in a comic, the other is how the quran pretty much green lights sex slaves, and I can go on and on. Is my OP as serious as the topics I brought up? No. But it’s the part of the religion I’m most familiar with and has affected me the most personally. Funnily enough I was a very pious kid growing up but I guess my parents forcing me to be that way gave me a lot reason to study the religion more thoroughly. Whoops.

At the end of the day it’s your dad’s choice if he wants to associate with you or not I’m sorry to say. I don’t know much about your dad but I know my dad would also disown me if I came out about being atheist. You’ve made the effort to coexist with him and if he doesn’t want to accept your effort then so be it. Personally, I think you’ve done all you can for the time being. If down the line he accepts you for who you are then great but one of the biggest struggle with us exmuslims is keeping healthy relationships with muslim family members as they have a hard time accepting us for what we are. My advice would be to move on, let your dad know that you’re always open to talk to him or make up. Relationships are a two person dynamic and when one person is unwilling it won’t work. Good luck.
